findings.claim: Check returns a denial immediately from permDenialCache but ignores denials in the permission cache so that new grants are picked up. Once a denial is stored in permDenialCache, any permission granted afterward is blocked for up to the cache TTL.

TestService_getUserPermissions no longer has a cacheHit:true case, so the cacheHit field and both 'if tc.cacheHit' branches are dead. No test asserts the always-go-to-store behavior or the removed anonymous cache read.
The newly added log message 'could not check permission' starts with a lowercase letter, which violates the convention that messages start with a capital letter.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
